response.justification: The candidate lacks direct experience with C++ or Rust in geospatial routing pipelines, despite having broad full-stack exposure; their GIS work is open-source and non-production, with no evidence of routing tile optimization, real-time traffic integration, or low-latency distributed systems at scale — core requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive open-source GIS experience with GISCollective
Proven ability to work across diverse tech stacks and languages
Strong track record in testing, CI/CD, and developer tooling
concerns: No demonstrated C++ or Rust production experience in routing or geospatial pipelines
Lacks evidence of distributed systems, fault tolerance, or routing data optimization
Primary tech stack is JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang, not aligned with C++ requirement
